form.formComment: Back after a long spell. Finished off last preparation 4th of 14 in the LR Karaka Millions 2yo at Ellerslie on January 24 over 1200m, on a slow track; 3.5 len behind Dream Roca with 55kg at $10. Won previous preparation first up scored a big 5 len win in a 2yo SWP at Otaki on September 26 over 800m on a heavy track defeating Spellbound carrying 55kg at $1.70.
